syncs.description: Make meeting records and their full detail available as a replicated dataset. A personal connection includes owned and shared meetings with private notes only where permitted; a workspace connection includes workspace meetings without private notes.
syncs.name: sync-meetings

userId.description: Opaque ID of the Jamie user who recorded the meeting.

userEmail.description: Email of the Jamie recording user.

markdown.description: Full summary as ordinary Markdown text.

html.description: Full summary as HTML; render as untrusted HTML safely.

transcript.description: Full Markdown transcript with speaker labels preserved.

participants.description: People detected speaking, not the invited calendar attendee list.

tasks.description: Embedded action items without writable task IDs; use the tasks dataset for task identities.

id.description: Internal calendar event ID, or null if unlinked.

title.description: Calendar title, falling back to meeting title.

scheduledTime.description: Scheduled start instant normalized to UTC Z.

endTime.description: Event end instant in UTC Z, or null when unavailable.

organizer.description: Whether this attendee organized the event.

event.description: Linked calendar context or provider fallback meeting data if unlinked.

endTime.description: Meeting end instant in UTC Z, null when unset and omitted if absent.

generatedTitle.description: AI-generated title, null when unset and omitted if absent.

scratchpadNotes.description: Private Markdown notes on personal owned meetings; null for personal shared/no-note cases, omitted for workspace records.

Meetings.description: Full Jamie meeting records with recorder references, summary, transcript, speakers, action items, tags and calendar context.

syncs.description: Make tags owned by or shared with a personal connection available as a replicated dataset, preserving names and shared status.
syncs.name: sync-tags

id.description: Opaque Jamie tag ID identifying this tag record.

name.description: Tag name usable as tagName in list-meetings.

shared.description: True when another user shared this tag with the connection user, false when the connection user owns it.

Tags.description: A Jamie tag owned by or shared with the personal connection user.

syncs.description: Make meeting action items available as a replicated dataset, including completion, due dates, priority, assignee and source meeting. Personal connections include owned and shared tasks; workspace connections include workspace tasks. Requires either Personal or Workspace scope.
syncs.name: sync-tasks

id.description: Opaque Jamie task ID usable as taskId in update-task subject to write authority.

userId.description: Opaque Jamie ID of the user who recorded the source meeting, not the assignee.

dueDate.description: Calendar due date in YYYY-MM-DD form, null when unset and omitted if absent.

assignee.description: Assigned person, null if unassigned and omitted if absent.

id.description: Opaque assignee person ID, or null when unavailable.

email.description: Assignee email, or null when unavailable.

priority.description: Task priority or null when unset; omitted if absent.

completed.description: Whether the action item is marked done.

createdAt.description: Task creation instant normalized to UTC Z with fractional precision preserved.

meetingId.description: Opaque ID of the source meeting.

meetingTitle.description: Source meeting title, null when unset and omitted if absent.

Tasks.description: Jamie meeting action item, including its recorder, assignee, completion and source meeting.

functions.name: delete-meeting
functions.description: Permanently delete a meeting and its related data, including summary, transcript and tasks. Personal connections can delete only owned meetings; workspace connections can delete meetings owned by workspace members.

meetingId.description: Opaque ID of the meeting to permanently delete, subject to the connection's ownership or workspace authority.

id.description: Opaque meeting ID confirmed deleted by Jamie.

deleted.description: True only when Jamie confirms the deletion succeeded.

FunctionOutput_jamie_deletemeeting.description: Provider confirmation that the meeting and its related data were permanently deleted.

keyType.description: The actual scope of the API key stored on this connection, set during connection setup.

tags.instructions: Obtain the meeting ID from `list-meetings`, `list-workspace-meetings`, or `get-meeting`. This permanently removes the meeting and related summary, transcript and tasks and cannot be undone. Shared personal meetings cannot be deleted. A workspace connection can delete a meeting only when its owner belongs to that workspace. After an uncertain result, check with `get-meeting` before repeating.

functions.name: get-meeting
functions.description: Get a meeting's summary, transcript, participants, action items, tags and calendar context. A personal connection also returns private scratchpad notes for meetings it owns.

meetingId.description: Opaque Jamie meeting ID obtained from a meeting list or search result.

FunctionInput_jamie_getmeeting.description: Identify the Jamie meeting to retrieve.

id.description: Opaque Jamie meeting ID.

title.description: Meeting title, preserved as supplied by Jamie.

startTime.description: Meeting start instant normalized to UTC with Z without losing fractional precision.

endTime.description: Meeting end instant in UTC with Z; null when unset and omitted if absent.

generatedTitle.description: AI-generated title; null when unset and omitted if not returned.

id.description: Opaque Jamie recorder user ID.

user.description: Jamie user who recorded the meeting, not necessarily a participant or organizer.

markdown.description: Meeting summary as ordinary Markdown text.

html.description: Meeting summary as HTML; consumers must render untrusted HTML safely.

summary.description: Provider-generated summary in its available representations.

transcript.description: Full Markdown transcript, including bold speaker names and original text.

scratchpadNotes.description: Private Markdown notes on a personal connection; null for shared meetings or no notes, and omitted for workspace connections.

id.description: Opaque participant ID.

email.description: Participant email, or null when unavailable.

items.description: A person detected speaking in the transcript.

participants.description: People detected speaking in the transcript, distinct from invited attendees.

completed.description: Whether the action item is marked done.

email.description: Assignee email, or null if unavailable.

assignee.description: Assigned person, or null if unassigned.

items.description: An embedded action-item snapshot without a writable task ID.

tasks.description: Embedded action-item snapshots without task IDs; use a task list for writable identifiers.

color.description: Provider tag hex color, such as #4A90D9.

items.description: An embedded meeting tag without a tag ID.

tags.description: Tags applied to this meeting; these embedded values have no tag ID.

id.description: Internal Jamie calendar event ID, or null if not linked.

externalId.description: Opaque external calendar provider event ID, or null if unavailable.

title.description: Calendar event title, falling back to meeting title.

scheduledTime.description: Scheduled start instant normalized to UTC with Z.

endTime.description: Event end instant normalized to UTC with Z, or null if unavailable.

responseStatus.description: Provider RSVP status, usually accepted, declined, tentative or needsAction; null when unknown. Other provider values are preserved.

organizer.description: Whether this attendee organized the event.

items.description: A calendar invitee, not necessarily a speaker or actual attendee.

attendees.description: People invited to the calendar event, whether or not they spoke or attended.

event.description: Calendar event context, falling back to meeting data when no calendar event is linked.

FunctionOutput_jamie_getmeeting.description: Full Jamie meeting content, recorder, detected speakers, action items, tags and calendar context.

keyType.description: Type of Jamie API key stored on this connection, set when connecting the account.

tags.instructions: Use a meeting ID from `list-meetings`, `list-workspace-meetings`, or `search-meetings`. Use this tool for full content rather than the abbreviated list records. Access follows the connection: personal connections can read owned and shared meetings; workspace connections can read workspace meetings but never private scratchpad notes. To obtain editable action-item IDs, use `list-tasks` or `list-workspace-tasks`; embedded meeting tasks do not contain those IDs.

functions.name: list-meetings
functions.description: List one page of owned and shared meetings, newest start time first, optionally restricted by start-time bounds or tag name.

limit.description: Maximum meeting records in this page; defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this connection and the same meeting filters; omit for the first page.

tagName.description: Tag name, not tag ID, used to filter meetings; omit for all available tags.

startTimeTo.description: Inclusive latest meeting start instant with an explicit UTC marker or offset; omit for no upper bound.

startTimeFrom.description: Inclusive earliest meeting start instant with an explicit UTC marker or offset; omit for no lower bound.

FunctionInput_jamie_listmeetings.description: Page controls and optional tag-name and meeting-start bounds for personal meetings.

id.description: Opaque meeting ID for get-meeting or delete-meeting.

userId.description: Opaque ID of the user who recorded the meeting.

endTime.description: Meeting end instant in UTC with Z, or null when unset; omitted if absent.

startTime.description: Meeting start instant in UTC with Z, preserving fractional precision.

generatedTitle.description: AI-generated title, null when unset; omitted if absent upstream.

calendarEventId.description: Opaque linked Jamie calendar event ID, null when unlinked; omitted if absent.

items.description: A meeting summary accessible to the personal connection.
One page of meeting summaries in descending meeting start-time order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next page with the same filters and connection; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_jamie_listmeetings.description: One personal meeting page and its continuation cursor, when available.

tags.instructions: Use this tool to browse personal owned/shared meetings. Use `list-workspace-meetings` for team-wide browsing with a workspace connection, `search-meetings` for semantic content matches, and `get-meeting` for full details. Obtain a tag name from `list-tags` if needed. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters to continue; limit is 1–100, default 50.

functions.name: list-tags
functions.description: List all tags owned by or shared with the personal connection, including whether each tag is shared.

FunctionInput_jamie_listtags.description: No parameters are required to list personal tags.

id.description: Opaque Jamie tag ID.

name.description: Tag name usable as the tagName filter in list-meetings.

shared.description: True if another user shared this tag with the connection user; false if the user owns it.

items.description: An owned or shared Jamie tag.
All tags available to the personal connection; no pagination or ordering guarantee.

FunctionOutput_jamie_listtags.description: The complete collection of tags available to the personal connection.

tags.instructions: Use with a personal connection to discover meeting tag names. Pass a returned name, not its ID, to tagName in `list-meetings`. The collection is returned in one response with no cursor. Workspace connections do not support tag listing.

functions.name: list-tasks
functions.description: List one page of action items extracted from owned and shared meetings, newest creation time first, with completion, meeting and creation-time filters.

limit.description: Maximum tasks in this page; defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this connection and identical task filters; omit for the first page.

completed.description: True returns completed tasks, false returns open tasks; omit to include both.

meetingId.description: Opaque source meeting ID restricting the task collection; omit for all accessible meetings.

createdAtTo.description: Inclusive latest task creation instant, with explicit timezone offset; omit for no upper bound.

createdAtFrom.description: Inclusive earliest task creation instant, with explicit timezone offset; omit for no lower bound.

FunctionInput_jamie_listtasks.description: Page controls and combined filters for accessible personal tasks.

id.description: Opaque task ID usable as taskId in update-task, subject to write access.

userId.description: Opaque Jamie ID of the user who recorded the source meeting, not the assignee.

dueDate.description: Calendar due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, null when unset; omitted if absent.

assignee.description: Assigned person, null if unassigned and omitted if absent.

id.description: Opaque assignee person ID, or null when unavailable.

email.description: Assignee email, or null when unavailable.

priority.description: Task priority or null when unset; omitted if absent.

completed.description: Whether the task is marked done.

createdAt.description: Task creation instant normalized to UTC Z without losing fractional precision.

meetingId.description: Opaque source meeting ID usable with get-meeting.

meetingTitle.description: Source meeting title, null when unset and omitted if absent.

items.description: An action item from an owned or shared meeting.
One page of tasks in descending creation-time order, including shared read-only tasks.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next page on the same connection and filters; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_jamie_listtasks.description: A single page of accessible tasks and an optional continuation cursor.

tags.instructions: Use with a personal connection to find action items and their writable IDs. For team-wide browsing use `list-workspace-tasks`. Pass a returned id as taskId to `update-task`; shared tasks are readable but not writable through a personal connection. A meetingId filter can come from `list-meetings` or `get-meeting`. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with unchanged filters; limit is 1–100, default 50.

functions.name: list-workspace-meetings
functions.description: List one page of workspace meetings, newest start time first, optionally filtered by recorder email and start-time bounds. Requires a workspace connection created by an administrator.

limit.description: Maximum meeting records in this page; defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from this connection and identical filters; omit for the first page.

userEmail.description: Recorder's email to filter the workspace collection, not an attendee email; omit for all workspace users.

startTimeTo.description: Inclusive latest meeting start instant with an explicit timezone offset; omit for no upper bound.

startTimeFrom.description: Inclusive earliest meeting start instant with an explicit timezone offset; omit for no lower bound.

FunctionInput_jamie_listworkspacemeeting.description: Page controls and optional recorder and inclusive start-time filters for workspace meetings.

id.description: Opaque meeting ID usable with get-meeting or delete-meeting.

userId.description: Opaque Jamie ID of the user who recorded the meeting.

endTime.description: Meeting end instant in UTC with Z, null if unset and omitted if absent.

startTime.description: Meeting start instant in UTC with Z, without fractional precision loss.

generatedTitle.description: AI-generated title, null if unset and omitted if absent.

calendarEventId.description: Opaque linked Jamie calendar event ID, null if unlinked and omitted if absent.

items.description: A workspace meeting summary without full meeting content.
One page of workspace meeting summaries, newest start time first.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token scoped to this connection and filters; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_jamie_listworkspacemeetin.description: One workspace meeting page and its optional continuation token.

tags.instructions: Use for team-wide meeting browsing with a workspace connection. Use `list-meetings` for personal owned/shared browsing and tag-name filtering. Use `get-meeting` for full content. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters; limit is 1–100, default 50. Workspace access includes other members' meetings but not their private scratchpad notes.

functions.name: list-workspace-tasks
functions.description: List one page of workspace action items, newest creation time first, optionally filtered by recorder email, creation time, completion or meeting. Requires an administrator-created workspace connection.

limit.description: Maximum task records in this page; defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor for the same connection and filters; omit for the first page.

completed.description: True includes only done tasks, false only open tasks; omit to include both states.

meetingId.description: Opaque source meeting ID restricting the collection; omit for all workspace meetings.

userEmail.description: Recording user's email restricting the workspace collection, not an assignee filter; omit for all users.

createdAtTo.description: Inclusive latest task creation instant with explicit timezone offset; omit for no upper bound.

createdAtFrom.description: Inclusive earliest task creation instant with explicit timezone offset; omit for no lower bound.

FunctionInput_jamie_listworkspacetasks.description: Filters and opaque continuation cursor for one page of workspace tasks.

id.description: Opaque task ID usable with update-task, subject to workspace membership.

userId.description: Opaque recorder user ID, distinct from the task's assignee.

dueDate.description: Calendar due date YYYY-MM-DD, null when unset and omitted if absent.

assignee.description: Assigned person, null if unassigned and omitted if absent.

id.description: Opaque person ID or null if unavailable.

email.description: Assignee email or null if unavailable.

priority.description: Task priority, null when unset and omitted if absent.

completed.description: Whether the task is marked done.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC Z without fractional precision loss.

meetingId.description: Opaque source meeting ID usable with get-meeting.

meetingTitle.description: Source meeting title, null when unset and omitted if absent.

items.description: A workspace action item and its source meeting and recorder.
One page of workspace tasks, newest creation time first.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token for this connection and filters; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_jamie_listworkspacetasks.description: One workspace task page with an optional continuation cursor.

tags.instructions: Use for team-wide action-item browsing with a workspace connection. Use `list-tasks` for personal owned/shared browsing. Obtain meeting IDs from `list-workspace-meetings` if filtering by meeting. Pass returned task id to `update-task`. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters; limit is 1–100, default 50. userEmail refers to the recording user, not the task assignee.

functions.name: search-meetings
functions.description: Find relevant text excerpts in owned and shared meetings using semantic similarity. Returns up to 40 relevance-ranked chunks, not a list of unique meetings.

query.description: Ordinary text question or topic for semantic matching against meeting content.

startTimeTo.description: Inclusive latest source-meeting start instant, with explicit timezone offset; omit to retain Jamie's default upper-bound behavior.

startTimeFrom.description: Inclusive earliest source-meeting start instant, with explicit timezone offset; omit to retain Jamie's default lower-bound behavior.

FunctionInput_jamie_searchmeetings.description: Semantic meeting search query and optional inclusive source-meeting start bounds.

id.description: Opaque matching chunk ID, not a meeting ID.

text.description: Matching text excerpt as ordinary decoded text.

meetingId.description: Opaque source meeting ID usable with get-meeting.

meetingDate.description: Provider source-meeting calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form, kept as a date rather than an instant.

meetingTitle.description: Source meeting title, or null if unset.

items.description: One relevance-ranked matching text chunk and its source meeting.
Matching chunks in provider relevance order; multiple chunks may reference one meeting, and no pagination is offered.

FunctionOutput_jamie_searchmeetings.description: A single bounded set of semantic meeting search excerpts.

tags.instructions: Use for questions or topic matches in meeting content with a personal connection. Use `list-meetings` for chronological browsing or tag filters, and `get-meeting` with a result's meetingId for full context. Without date bounds, Jamie searches the last six months. Results are at most 40 chunks and may include several chunks from the same meeting; there is no continuation token. Narrow the query or bounds if needed.

functions.name: update-task
functions.description: Partially update a task's text, completion state or both. Personal connections can update only owned tasks; workspace connections can update tasks owned by current workspace members.

text.description: Replacement action-item text. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; the resulting text must be 1–10,000 characters. Omit to preserve text; null or empty text cannot clear it.

taskId.description: Opaque task ID from a task list, writable under the current connection.

completed.description: True marks done and false reopens; omit to preserve completion. Null is not supported.

FunctionInput_jamie_updatetask.description: A task ID and the text, completion state, or both to update; omitted fields remain unchanged.

id.description: Opaque updated task ID confirmed by Jamie.

text.description: Updated trimmed task text, present only when text was supplied.

completed.description: Updated completion state, present only when completed was supplied.

FunctionOutput_jamie_updatetask.description: Jamie's acknowledgment containing the task ID and only the supplied update fields.

keyType.description: The authority of the API key stored on this connection: Personal or Workspace.

tags.instructions: Get taskId from the id field in `list-tasks` or `list-workspace-tasks`; embedded tasks from `get-meeting` have no editable IDs. Supply text to edit, completed:true to complete, or completed:false to reopen; at least one must be supplied. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Text is trimmed and must contain 1–10,000 characters after trimming. Shared tasks are read-only through personal connections. The result contains only the fields changed, not the full task.
